commentary.bulkers: Jierui Shipping have committed their Capesize "Jian Fa" 175/2004 SWS, China (SS 08/2029, DD 07/2027, Scrubber fitted) to undisclosed interests at USD 18,5 mill. By way of comparison, the one-year-younger sister vessel "XH Navigator" 174/2005 SWS, China (SS 11/2030, DD 01/2029, Scrubber fitted) was sold in May at xs USD 20 mill. The Kamsarmax "Velos Jasper" 82/2012 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS/DD 11/2026, Scrubber fitted) of Velos Dry was committed to Chinese interests at USD 23,5 mill, while the sister vessel "Mont Fort" 82/2012 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS/DD 02/2027, Scrubber fitted) was sold a month ago at USD 22 mill. In addition, d'Amico Dry committed their "Medi Positano" 81/2015 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS 08/2030, DD 10/2028, Scrubber fitted) to Greek interests at USD 31,6 mill, and Tokei Kaiun committed the similar "Royal Hope" 81/2015 JMU, Japan (SS 05/2030, DD 05/2028) at USD 31 mill. Following the sale of the Panamax "G. B. Corrado" 77/2008 Oshima, Japan (SS/DD 03/2028) at USD 15 mill, Gestion Maritime have now committed the sister vessel "Francesco Corrado" 77/2008 Oshima, Japan (SS/DD 05/2028) to Korean interests at USD 15 mill also. On the Supramax sector, NYK Line committed the "Global Oriole" 58/2012 NACKS, China (SS/DD 04/2027, Scrubber fitted) at mid USD 19 mill. For reference, the one-year-younger sister vessel "Crimson Knight" 58/2013 NACKS, China (SS/DD 01/2028) was sold back in May at USD 19,1 mill. Moreover, the "Glory Bridge" 50/2001 Mitsui, Japan (SS 07/2031, DD 06/2029) was committed at USD 7,5 mill. Remind you that back in May, the sister vessel "Meraklis" 50/2001 Mitsui, Japan (SS 07/2028, DD 07/2026) was sold at USD 6,3 mill.
commentary.tankers: SONANGOL have committed their Suezmax "Sonangol Namibe" 158/2007 Daewoo, Korea (SS/DD 03/2027) at USD 49,5 mill. Remind you that a couple of months ago, the "Cosmo Sail" 159/2007 Hyundai Samho, Korea (SS/DD 07/2027) was sold at the same price. Furhermore, CMB. Tech committed their "Bristol" 157/2024 Hyundai Samho, Korea (SS 02/2029, DD 02/2027, Scrubber fitted) to clients of Naftomar at USD 123 mill. For reference, the one-year-older "Brugge" & "Brest" 157/2023 Hyundai Samho, Korea (SS/DD 07/2028 & SS/DD 10/2028, Scrubber fitted) were committed in May at USD 112 mill each. The MR1 "Maersk Kate" 39/2010 Guangzhou, China (SS 08/2030, DD 10/2028) of Maersk Tankers was committed to Greek interests at USD 21,9 mill. Note that the sister vessel "Kirsten Maersk" 39/2010 Guangzhou, China (SS 06/2030, DD 07/2028) was sold back in April at USD 22 mill.

freight.Capesize: Iron ore rates on the West Australia to China route moved within a tight range, with Port Hedland and Dampier to Qingdao fixtures settling between USD 13.40/14.00 fio. In the Atlantic, long-haul departures from Seven Islands and Port Cartier to Qingdao and Kakogawa reached USD 43.00 fio and USD 49.25 fio respectively, while a West Africa run from Owendo to East Coast India fetched USD 45.75 fio. Out of South Africa, a Saldanha Bay trip to Qingdao secured USD 24.98 fio.
freight.Kamsarmax / Panamax: In the Pacific, NoPac trips with Singapore-Japan options settled between USD 15,500/16,100 pd. Australian rounds with redelivery in China, Japan, India and Singapore-Japan ranges fetched between USD 15,500/19,000 pd. Indonesian coal runs to South China, Japan and regional destinations achieved between USD 14,100/21,250 pd, while a fertiliser run via Yangtze River to ECSA made USD 6,500 pd. From East Coast India, West Coast India and South East Asia, trips via ECSA and South Africa to India and Singapore- Japan range obtained USD 19,500/22,000 pd, alongside an ECSA departure fixing at USD 19,750 pd plus USD 975,000 ballast bonus. In the Atlantic, a Continent trip via USEC to South East Asia reached USD 30,750 pd. On period, activity was active with fixtures for 5 to 10 months duration agreed between USD 15,500/19,000 pd, while a 11 to 13 months period was secured at 112% of the P5TC index.
freight.Ultramax / Supramax: In the Pacific, a NoPac round settled at USD 16,500 pd, while an Australian run to Japan fetched USD 21,000 pd. Indonesian coal trips with options to India, Thailand and regional destinations achieved between USD 16,000/23,000 pd, whereas nickel ore and clinker runs made USD 19,000 pd and USD 16,000 pd respectively. Out of India, regional trips to Bangladesh and Chittagong secured between USD 25,000/25,500 pd, a West Coast India run to Japan fixed at USD 17,000 pd and a West Africa trip via Owendo to India achieved USD 27,000 pd. Out of South Africa, trips to China and India range obtained between USD 23,500/25,000 pd, alongside ballast bonuses ranging from USD 235,000 to USD 250,000. In the Atlantic, transatlantic grain and petcoke runs from USEC and US Gulf reached USD 28,000 pd and USD 34,000 pd respectively. On period, vessels secured between USD 20,750/21,000 pd for durations ranging from 6 to 10 months.
freight.Handymax / Handysize: In the Pacific, a trip from South East Asia via Australia to Japan fetched USD 20,500 pd. In the Atlantic, an ECSA run to West Africa secured USD 16,750 pd. Out of the Mediterranean, a departure from East Med to NCSA and US Gulf range made USD 9,850 pd, while a long-haul trip from West Med via ECSA to Persian Gulf fixed at USD 9,500 pd.
